_source.description: Major global vanadium mining, processing, and production sites
_source.origin: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024 (https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2024/mcs2024-vanadium.pdf); USGS Mineral Resources Data System (https://mrdata.usgs.gov/mrds/); S&P Global Market Intelligence mine profiles; Pangang Group Vanadium Titanium & Resources (SHE: 000629) annual reports; EVRAZ plc (LSE: EVR) Annual Report 2023; Bushveld Minerals (AIM: BMN) Annual Report 2023; Largo Inc. (TSX: LGO / NASDAQ: LGO) Annual Report 2023; HBIS Group (Chengde Vanadium-Titanium) company disclosures; AMG Advanced Metallurgical Group (AMS: AMG) annual reports; Australian Vanadium Limited (ASX: AVL), TNG Limited (ASX: TNG), Technology Metals Australia (ASX: TMT) annual reports and ASX filings; Glencore (LSE: GLEN) Annual Report 2023; MC Mining (ASX: MCM) annual reports
_source.license: USGS: public domain; company data: fair use summary
_source.notes: Major vanadium operations globally. Vanadium is predominantly a byproduct of titaniferous magnetite (vanadium-bearing iron ore) smelting and steel slag processing. Few mines are dedicated vanadium producers. Coordinates from USGS MRDS, company filings, and satellite verification. Production/capacity figures from 2023 where available. Capacity in V2O5 equivalent tonnes per annum. Global production ~100,000 t V content/yr (~178,000 t V2O5 equivalent).

_coverage.known_gaps: Smaller Chinese vanadium-from-stone-coal operations in Hubei, Hunan, and Guizhou provinces; secondary vanadium recovery from spent catalysts and oil residues; Russian producers beyond EVRAZ (Vostochny, etc.)

sites.name: Panzhihua Vanadium-Titanium Complex
sites.ownership: Ansteel Group (state-owned parent of Pangang Group)
sites.grade: 0.3% V2O5 in ore; 1.6% V2O5 in slag
sites.notes: World's largest vanadium producer; Panxi Rift region, Sichuan Province; vanadium extracted from blast furnace slag of titaniferous magnetite smelting; produces ~30% of global V2O5

sites.name: Chengde Vanadium-Titanium
sites.notes: Chengde, Hebei Province; second-largest Chinese vanadium producer; vanadium recovered from blast furnace slag of local titaniferous magnetite ores

sites.name: Xichang Vanadium Plant
sites.notes: Xichang, Sichuan Province; Panxi region vanadium from steel slag; significant Chinese producer

sites.name: Miyi Mine (Hongge Deposit)
sites.notes: Miyi County, Sichuan Province; Hongge layered intrusion hosts massive V-Ti-Fe resources; feeds multiple steel mills in Panxi region

sites.name: Shanyang Vanadium (Stone Coal)
sites.ownership: Multiple operators (Shaanxi vanadium from stone coal)
sites.notes: Shanyang County, Shaanxi Province; vanadium extraction from stone coal (carbonaceous shale); China has ~8.7 Mt V2O5 in stone coal reserves; environmentally challenging process

sites.name: Enshi Stone Coal District
sites.notes: Enshi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hubei Province; significant stone coal vanadium district; production highly sensitive to V2O5 prices and environmental enforcement

sites.name: Nizhny Tagil Metallurgical Combine
sites.ownership: EVRAZ plc (LSE delisted post-sanctions; Russian ownership)
sites.grade: 0.5-0.7% V2O5 in ore; 8-14% V2O5 in converter slag
sites.notes: Sverdlovsk Oblast; EVRAZ NTMK (Nizhnetagilsky Metallurgichesky Kombinat); vanadium extracted from converter slag of Kachkanar ore smelting; one of world's largest vanadium producers; Tula and Nizhny Tagil plants process V-bearing slag

sites.name: Kachkanar Mining & Processing Complex (KGOK)
sites.grade: 0.13-0.15% V2O5 in ore; 0.5-0.7% V2O5 in concentrate
sites.notes: Kachkanar, Sverdlovsk Oblast; Gusevogorsky massif; one of Russia's largest iron ore mines; ore contains vanadium extracted downstream at NTMK; open-pit with ~55 Mt/yr ore capacity

sites.name: Tula Vanadium Processing Plant
sites.notes: EVRAZ Vanady-Tula processing plant; converts vanadium-bearing converter slag from EVRAZ NTMK into ferrovanadium and V2O5; one of Russia's two major V processing facilities

sites.name: Vametco Vanadium Mine
sites.notes: Brits, North West Province; Bushveld Igneous Complex Upper Zone; one of only three primary vanadium producers in South Africa; salt-roast process

sites.name: Rhovan Vanadium Mine
sites.notes: Near Brits, North West Province; Bushveld Complex; integrated mining and processing; one of the world's largest primary V producers; kiln-based V2O5 extraction

sites.name: Mapochs Mine
sites.ownership: MC Mining (ASX: MCM) — acquired via Baobab Mining
sites.notes: Roossenekal, Limpopo Province; eastern limb of Bushveld Complex; historically significant vanadium mine; placed on care and maintenance; potential restart under investigation

sites.name: Vanggatfontein (Brits Vanadium)
sites.notes: Vanchem processing facility near Brits; processes purchased magnetite concentrate from multiple Bushveld Complex sources; salt roast and acid leach technology

sites.name: Highveld Steel Vanadium (closed)
sites.notes: eMalahleni (Witbank), Mpumalanga; EVRAZ Highveld was once a major V producer before liquidation in 2015; Bushveld Complex eastern limb; assets partially acquired by various parties

sites.name: Steelpoortdrift Project
sites.notes: Eastern limb of Bushveld Complex, Limpopo Province; Bushveld's expansion project; PFS completed; would feed existing Vanchem processing plant

sites.name: Mokopane (Maugen) Project
sites.notes: Northern limb of Bushveld Complex, Limpopo Province; large defined resource; greenfield development project

sites.name: Maracas Menchen Mine
sites.notes: Maracas, Bahia state; one of the world's highest-grade primary vanadium deposits; only significant vanadium producer in the Americas; kiln-based salt roast extraction; Largo also developing VCHARGE vanadium redox flow battery

sites.name: Mt Peake Project
sites.notes: ~235km north of Alice Springs, NT; TIVAN hydrometallurgical process planned for polymetallic recovery; EIS approved by NT Government; offtake with WOOJIN and SMS Group

sites.name: Gabanintha Project
sites.grade: 0.86% V2O5 in massive magnetite; 1.1% V2O5 in concentrate
sites.notes: Near Meekatharra, WA; one of the highest-grade V projects globally; DFS completed 2022; conventional salt-roast process planned

sites.name: Australian Vanadium Project (Meekatharra)
sites.notes: Near Meekatharra, WA; DFS completed; integrated mine-to-battery-grade V2O5 strategy; vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB) market target

sites.name: Windimurra Vanadium Project
sites.notes: Near Mt Magnet, WA; Windimurra Igneous Complex; plant built but placed on care and maintenance due to low V prices; one of Australia's largest defined V resources

sites.name: Gibellini Project
sites.ownership: Sunrise New Energy (formerly Nevada Vanadium Mining Corp.)
sites.notes: Eureka County, Nevada; only permitted primary vanadium mine in the US; the US imports ~90% of its vanadium; heap leach process planned

sites.name: AMG Vanadium (Zanesville Plant)
sites.operator: AMG Vanadium (AMG Advanced Metallurgical Group subsidiary)
sites.notes: Zanesville, Ohio; largest vanadium recycler in North America; processes spent catalysts, fly ash, and V-bearing residues; significant V supply source outside primary mining

sites.name: Titania AS (Tellnes Mine)
sites.notes: Tellnes open-pit mine, Rogaland, southern Norway; primary ilmenite (TiO2) producer; small vanadium byproduct recovery; one of Europe's largest titanium ore mines

sites.name: Mustavaara Mine (revival project)
sites.notes: Former Otanmaki Oy vanadium mine near Taivalkoski, NE Finland; operated 1976-1985; reopening feasibility under study; EU critical raw materials list includes vanadium

sites.name: Catabola Project
sites.notes: Bie Province, central Angola; early-stage exploration of V-Ti-Fe intrusive complex; limited infrastructure

sites.name: Sukhoi Log (Vanadium byproduct)
sites.notes: Bodaybo district, Irkutsk Oblast; world's largest undeveloped gold deposit; vanadium-enriched carbonaceous sediments could yield V byproduct; under study

sites.name: Lac Dore Complex
sites.notes: Chibougamau, Quebec; Archean layered intrusion; NI 43-101 resource defined; VanadiumCorp developing Electrochem process for V extraction
